target_release: resolved from the published release pin
dependencies: model available to the configured Codex account

assertions: each execution records its requested and resolved version
each execution records exactly one successful shipping_quote call and the structured quote

compatibility.status: requires live verification and provider access

network: The server is local stdio. Each pinned runtime requires release metadata and archive access unless it already has a valid cache entry. Both runs require model provider access through the configured Codex login.
credentials: Use the existing Codex login and select a model available to that account. Runtime download does not create provider credentials.
cleanup: MCPTestKit closes each harness and server process; managed binaries remain in the user cache unless an explicit temporary cache is supplied.
